title: Open Values Edges v0.1
description: A list of sourced links between options, brands and companies, such as which company owns a brand or which bank is an alternative to another. Each link carries a source and a date.

format.description: Always "open-values-edges". Tells a reader that this file is a list of sourced links between entries.

version.description: The version of the edges format this file follows, 0.1.

note.description: A paragraph for maintainers saying what the edges cover and which checks hold them.

edges.description: The links. Each one says that one entry, brand or company relates to another in a named way, with a source and a date.

from.description: The id of the thing the link starts from, written "ovs:" then a group and a code, such as "ovs:banking/us-bank" for an entry in the banking facts file or "ovs:brand/nestle" for a brand.

rel.description: How the two are related, in lower case with hyphens. The file uses "owned-by" (a brand owned by a company), "parent-of" (the same ownership read from the company's side) and "alternative-to" (an option to consider instead).

to.description: The id of the thing the link points to, in the same "ovs:group/code" form as from.

source.description: Where the link is shown to be true, usually a web address.

asof.description: When the link was true, as a year such as "2026" or a full date.
